what_happened.line: The Select Board moved to ratify two town manager appointments, a head accounting clerk and a Council on Aging van driver, but the vote results were not audible.
The board's motion on the van driver appointment was made, and the minutes note that training for the driver is paid for from the budget.
Payroll, payroll deduction, school payroll and accounts payable warrants were read out.
A proposed percentage split of electricity costs between the town and the schools was put off to a later meeting in April.
The manager said a snow and ice deficit adjustment was already made at the Finance Committee meeting, and warrant article work was set for April 4 and 11, with follow-up April 18.

why_it_matters: How electricity costs are divided between the town and school budgets is still undecided, and the split changes which budget, and so which part of the tax bill, carries that cost.
Warrant article work in April shapes what residents are later asked to vote on at Town Meeting.
watch_next: Select Board meetings on April 4, 11 and 18 for warrant article work and the electricity split.
The Finance Committee budget hearing the manager said is set for Thursday.
